entities.name: Brims Barone
entities.description: A human rogue and mobster boss who controls the hat market at Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun.

entities.name: Myra the Magnificent
entities.description: Owner of the Astrotorium who deals with Barone for hats.

entities.name: Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun
entities.description: The amusement park where Barone runs his hat racket.

entities.name: Barone's father
entities.description: An unsuccessful haberdasher, controlling about hats.

events.summary: As a child, envious of others' hats, Brims decides to one day control all hats.
events.quote: he decided to one day have all hats under his control

events.summary: Brims runs a hat racket in the Astrotorium, with enforcers muscling outsiders.
events.location: Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun
events.quote: His hired enforcers muscle anyone entering from outside the park with a hat not from him.

relations.quote: Brims was the son of an unsuccessful haberdasher

relations.note: She must deal with him for all things hats.
relations.quote: Myra knows that part of the cost of doing business is dealing with Barone
